def carrierAt (s : Sys) (aid : Nat) : Option Carrier :=
  s.carriers.find? (fun c => c.aid == aid)

def pendingAt (s : Sys) (ref : Singular.OutRef) : Option TerminationEntry :=
  s.terminations.find? (fun e => e.booking.request.reference == ref)

abbrev Result := Flow × Sys

-- The application carrier holds the minimum ADA `Mc`, the checkpoint's deposit and
-- freeze bond `D`, and above them the initial premium pool the registrant chooses.
-- A carrier short of `Mc + D` is refused.

def registrationShape (p : Params) (b : Singular.RegistrationBooking) : Prop :=
  p.Mc + p.D ≤ b.request.carrierAda ∧ b.request.declaredTip = p.tip

def bookRegistration (p : Params) (s : Sys)
    (b : Singular.RegistrationBooking) : Except String Result := do
  if ¬ registrationShape p b then throw "keri-registration-value-mismatch"
  let world ← Singular.book s.toWorld b
  let after := { s with registrations := b :: s.registrations }
  if after.toWorld ≠ world then throw "keri-registration-reconstruction-mismatch"
  pure ({ deposited := b.request.contents.lovelace }, after)

-- Rename the old tomb stage to explicit pending: it is an extant convicted
-- carrier awaiting booking, not a retired registry key. This retains the
-- two-stage transport boundary and does not invent atomic CP equivalence.

def convictCkpt (env : Env) (s : Sys) (aid : Nat) : Except String Result := do
  let some c := carrierAt s aid | throw "keri-carrier-missing"
  if c.st == .terminationPending || env.duplicity aid c.k != true then
    throw "keri-conviction-refused"
  let carriers := s.carriers.map (fun old =>
    if old.aid == aid then { old with st := .terminationPending } else old)
  pure ({}, { s with carriers := carriers })

def bookTermination (p : Params) (s : Sys)
    (aid booker fee : Nat) (b : Singular.TerminationBooking) : Except String Result := do
  let some c := carrierAt s aid | throw "keri-carrier-missing"
  if c.st != .terminationPending then throw "keri-conviction-required"
  if ¬ (b.request.key = aid ∧ b.request.destination = c.original.output ∧
      b.custodyInputs = [c.original] ∧ c.minAda = p.Mc ∧
      b.request.carrierAda = p.Mr ∧ b.request.declaredTip = p.tip ∧
      b.request.contents.lovelace = p.Mr + p.tip) then
    throw "keri-termination-binding-mismatch"
  let world ← Singular.bookTermination s.toWorld b
  let e : TerminationEntry := { booking := b, payload := {
    aid := aid, token := c.token, keyState := c.k, original := c.original,
    booker := booker, bookingFee := fee } }
  let after := { s with
    carriers := s.carriers.filter (fun old => old.aid != aid),
    terminations := e :: s.terminations }
  if after.toWorld ≠ world then throw "keri-termination-reconstruction-mismatch"
  pure ({
    premium := some (booker, p.Mc - p.Mr - p.tip),
    bookingFee := fee, intoRequest := p.Mr + p.tip }, after)

-- Inception stays a KERI processing guard, as in the existing coarse model.
-- A generic application approval does not stand in for that premise.

def registrationsAuthorized (env : Env) (members : List Singular.FoldMember) : Bool :=
  members.all (fun m => match m with
    | .registration b => env.inception b.request.key
    | .termination _ => true)

def installMember (p : Params) (before : Sys) (acc : Sys)
    (member : Singular.FoldMember) : Except String Sys := do
  letI : BEq Singular.RegistrationBooking := instBEqOfDecidableEq
  match member with
  | .termination b => do
    let some e := pendingAt before b.request.reference
      | throw "keri-termination-metadata-missing"
    if e.booking ≠ b then throw "keri-termination-metadata-mismatch"
    pure acc
  | .registration b => do
    if b ∉ before.registrations then throw "keri-registration-metadata-missing"
    let c : Carrier := {
      aid := b.request.key, token := acc.nextToken,
      original := { key := b.request.key, kind := .active,
                    output := b.request.destination, datum := b.request.datum },
      k := 0, st := .live, minAda := p.Mc }
    pure { acc with
      carriers := c :: acc.carriers,
      bindings := (c.aid, c.token) :: acc.bindings, nextToken := acc.nextToken + 1 }

def foldResult (p : Params) (s : Sys) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction)
    (world : Singular.World) : Except String Result := do
  let members := Singular.foldMembers s.toWorld tx
  let acc ← members.foldlM (installMember p s) s
  let after := { acc with
    gen := s.gen + 1,
    config := world.registry.config, trie := world.registry.trie, treasury := world.treasury,
    registrations := s.registrations.filter (fun b =>
      !Singular.inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs b.request.reference),
    terminations := s.terminations.filter (fun e =>
      !Singular.inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs e.booking.request.reference) }
  if after.toWorld ≠ world then throw "keri-fold-reconstruction-mismatch"
  let locked := members.filterMap (fun m => match m with
    | .registration b => some (b.request.key, b.request.carrierAda - p.Mc)
    | .termination _ => none)
  pure ({ locked := locked }, after)

def fold (p : Params) (env : Env) (s : Sys) (expectedGen expectedPlugin : Nat)
    (u : Singular.EconomicUtxo) (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction) : Except String Result := do
  if expectedGen != s.gen then throw "keri-generation-mismatch"
  if expectedPlugin != s.config.applicationPolicy then throw "keri-plugin-mismatch"
  let members := Singular.foldMembers s.toWorld tx
  if !registrationsAuthorized env members then throw "keri-inception-refused"
  let world ← Singular.foldAccepted s.toWorld u tx
  foldResult p s tx world

-- These wrappers expose only the already imported generic recovery judgment.
-- They do not claim to discharge broader KERI application recovery in #468,
-- nor inherit legacy Registry recovery statements by sharing a name.

def recoverRegistrations (s : Sys) (world : Singular.World) : Except String Sys := do
  let after := { s with registrations := s.registrations.filter (fun b =>
    world.pending.contains b) }
  if after.toWorld ≠ world then throw "keri-recovery-reconstruction-mismatch"
  pure after

def genericRetraction (s : Sys) (u : Singular.EconomicUtxo)
    (tx : Singular.EconomicTransaction) : Except String Result := do
  let world ← Singular.retractionAccepted s.toWorld u tx
  let after ← recoverRegistrations s world
  pure ({}, after)

def genericRejection (s : Sys) (u : Singular.EconomicUtxo)
    (tx : Singular.Rejection) : Except String Result := do
  let world ← Singular.rejectionAccepted s.toWorld u tx
  let after ← recoverRegistrations s world
  pure ({}, after)

def stepFn (p : Params) (env : Env) (action : Action) (s : Sys) : Except String Result :=
  match action with
  | .bookRegistration b => bookRegistration p s b
  | .convictCkpt aid => convictCkpt env s aid
  | .bookTermination aid booker fee b => bookTermination p s aid booker fee b
  | .fold gen plugin u tx => fold p env s gen plugin u tx
  | .genericRetraction u tx => genericRetraction s u tx
  | .genericRejection u tx => genericRejection s u tx

def registrationApplicationTagValid (c : Config) (r : RegistrationRequest)
    (tag : Approval) : Bool :=
  decide (tag.policy = c.applicationPolicy ∧ tag.edge = .insertActive ∧
    tag.key = r.key ∧ tag.owner = r.refundAddress ∧ tag.destination = r.destination ∧
    tag.assetName = applicationTagAssetName r.key r.refundAddress r.destination r.nonce)

def registrationDeclaredLovelace (r : RegistrationRequest) : Nat :=
  r.registrationCost + r.declaredTip + r.carrierAda

def registrationContentsShape (c : Config) (r : RegistrationRequest) : Bool :=
  decide (r.registryId = c.registryId ∧ r.registrationCost = c.registrationCost ∧
    c.minimumTip ≤ r.declaredTip ∧ r.contents.otherAssets = []) &&
  match r.contents.applicationTags with
  | [tag] => registrationApplicationTagValid c r tag
  | _ => false

def registrationBookingRefusal (c : Config) (b : RegistrationBooking) : Option String :=
  let r := b.request
  if !registrationContentsShape c r || r.contents.lovelace < registrationDeclaredLovelace r then
    some "dirty-request"
  else if registrationDeclaredLovelace r < r.contents.lovelace then
    some "hidden-surplus"
  else if !decide (r.contents.trieReadyTags = [r.trieReadyTag c] ∧ b.trieReadyTagsMinted = [r.trieReadyTag c]) then
    some "forged-trie-ready-tag"
  else if !decide (b.applicationTagsMinted = r.contents.applicationTags) then
    some "dirty-request"
  else if !decide b.interval.valid then
    some "invalid-booking-interval"
  else if r.submittedAt != b.interval.upper then
    some "backdated-booking"
  else if c.bookingWidth < b.interval.width then
    some "booking-too-wide"
  else none

def foldMemberRefusal (c : Config) (interval : Interval) (member : FoldMember) : Option String :=
  match member with
  | .registration b =>
    if interval.lower < b.request.submittedAt ||
        !inPhase1 c b.request.submittedAt interval.upper then some "not-phase1"
    else none
  | .termination _ => none

def foldPrerequisite (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Option String := do
  if ¬ (tx.transaction.inputs.map (·.ref)).Nodup then return "fold-duplicate-input"
  if !disjointInputs tx.transaction then return "fold-input-overlap"
  if let some why := inputPresenceRefusal u.ledger tx.transaction then return why
  if let some why := economicObservationRefusal world u tx then return why
  let members := foldMembers world tx
  if members.isEmpty then return "empty-fold"
  let some interval := tx.transaction.validity | return "fold-interval-missing"
  if ¬ interval.valid then return "fold-interval-empty"
  if let some why := members.findSome? (foldMemberRefusal world.registry.config interval) then return why
  if !(u.all fun p =>
      !inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs p.1 ||
      (foldMemberAt world p.1).isSome || p.2.output.stateTokens > 0 || foldOrdinary p.2) then
    return "fold-unrecognized-input"
  none

def foldAccepted (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Except String World :=
  match foldPrerequisite world u tx with
  | some why => .error why
  | none =>
    match foldBatch (foldProjectedRegistry world)
        ((foldMembers world tx).map (foldLegacyRequest world.registry.config)) with
    | .error why => .error why
    | .ok result =>
      match foldRoutingRefusal world u tx result with
      | some why => .error why
      | none => .ok (foldEffect world tx result)

def foldMemberAt (world : World) (reference : OutRef) : Option FoldMember :=
  match world.pending.find? (fun b => b.request.reference == reference) with
  | some b => some (.registration b)
  | none => (world.terminations.find? (fun b => b.request.reference == reference)).map
      FoldMember.termination

def foldMembers (world : World) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : List FoldMember :=
  tx.transaction.inputs.filterMap fun input => input.ref.bind (foldMemberAt world)

def FoldMember.tip : FoldMember → Nat
  | .registration b => b.request.declaredTip
  | .termination b => b.request.declaredTip

def FoldMember.donation : FoldMember → Nat
  | .registration b => b.request.registrationCost
  | .termination b => b.request.contents.lovelace - b.request.declaredTip

def FoldMember.carrier : FoldMember → Nat
  | .registration b => b.request.carrierAda
  | .termination _ => 0

def foldProjectedRegistry (world : World) : RegistryState :=
  { world.registry with held := world.registry.held ++ world.terminations.flatMap (·.custodyInputs) }

def foldRemainingTerminations (world : World) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : List TerminationBooking :=
  world.terminations.filter fun b => !inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs b.request.reference

def foldOrdinaryLovelace (outputs : List EconomicOutput) : Nat :=
  ((outputs.filter foldOrdinary).map (·.output.lovelace)).sum

def foldBareValue (output : EconomicOutput) : Bool :=
  output.output.assets.isEmpty && output.contents.otherAssets.isEmpty

def foldStateShape (c : Config) (output : EconomicOutput) : Bool :=
  decide (output.output.stateTokens = 1 ∧ output.output.stateToken = some c.stateToken ∧
    output.output.datum = .inline ∧ output.output.config = some c ∧
    output.request = none ∧ output.singularTags = [] ∧
    output.contents.trieReadyTags = [] ∧ output.contents.applicationTags = []) &&
    foldBareValue output

def foldSameQuantities {α : Type} [DecidableEq α]
    (left right : List (α × Int)) : Bool :=
  (left.map Prod.fst ++ right.map Prod.fst).all fun tag =>
    decide (((left.filter fun p => decide (p.1 = tag)).map Prod.snd).sum =
      ((right.filter fun p => decide (p.1 = tag)).map Prod.snd).sum)

def foldMint (c : Config) (members : List FoldMember) : List (SingularTag × Int) :=
  members.flatMap fun member => match member with
    | .registration b => [(c.singularTag b.request.key, 1)]
    | .termination b => b.request.singularTags.map (fun tag => (tag, -1))

def foldCarrierTags (c : Config) (members : List FoldMember) : List SingularTag :=
  members.filterMap fun member => match member with
    | .registration b => some (c.singularTag b.request.key)
    | .termination _ => none

def foldCarrierRefusal (c : Config) (outputs : List EconomicOutput)
    (member : FoldMember) : Option String := do
  match member with
  | .termination _ => none
  | .registration b =>
    let r := b.request
    let [output] := outputs.filter (fun o => o.singularTags.contains (c.singularTag r.key))
      | return "fold-destination-mismatch"
    if output.output.address != some r.destination || output.output.datumValue != r.datum ||
        output.output.datum != datumFormOf r.datum then return "fold-destination-mismatch"
    if output.output.lovelace != r.carrierAda then return "destination-carrier-mismatch"
    if !decide (output.singularTags = [c.singularTag r.key] ∧ output.output.stateTokens = 0 ∧
        output.request = none ∧ output.contents.trieReadyTags = [] ∧
        output.contents.applicationTags = []) || !foldBareValue output then
      return "fold-destination-mismatch"
    none

def foldRoutingRefusal (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction)
    (result : Result) : Option String := do
  let spent := economicSpent u tx
  let [state] := spent.filter (fun o => o.output.stateTokens > 0) | return "fold-state-missing"
  if !foldStateShape world.registry.config state ||
      world.registry.config.root != rootOf world.registry.trie then return "fold-state-mismatch"
  let [continued] := tx.outputs.filter (fun o => o.output.stateTokens > 0)
    | return "fold-state-mismatch"
  if !foldStateShape result.state.config continued then return "fold-state-mismatch"
  if continued.output.lovelace != state.output.lovelace then return "fold-state-value-mismatch"
  let members := foldMembers world tx
  if !requestTagsBurned u tx then return "fold-tag-not-burned"
  if let some why := members.findSome? (foldCarrierRefusal world.registry.config tx.outputs) then return why
  if !foldSameQuantities tx.singularMint (foldMint world.registry.config members) ||
      !decide ((tx.outputs.flatMap (·.singularTags)).Perm (foldCarrierTags world.registry.config members)) then
    return "fold-singular-mismatch"
  if !tx.stateMint.isEmpty || !tx.transaction.mint.isEmpty ||
      !(tx.outputs.all foldBareValue) || !(spent.all foldBareValue) then return "fold-foreign-asset"
  if tx.transaction.donation != (foldObligations members).donation then return "fold-donation-mismatch"
  if foldOrdinaryLovelace spent < tx.transaction.fee then return "fold-fee-funding-short"
  if !balanced u.ledger tx.transaction then return "fold-unbalanced"
  none
abbrev EconomicUtxo := List (OutRef × EconomicOutput)

def EconomicUtxo.ledger (u : EconomicUtxo) : Utxo :=
  u.map fun (ref, observed) => (ref, observed.output)

def economicLookup (u : EconomicUtxo) (ref : OutRef) : Option EconomicOutput :=
  (u.find? fun entry => entry.1 == ref).map Prod.snd

def economicSpent (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : List EconomicOutput :=
  (u.filter fun p => inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs p.1).map Prod.snd

def observesRegistration (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : RegistrationRequest) : Bool :=
  match economicLookup u r.reference with
  | none => false
  | some o => decide (o.request = some (.registration r) ∧ o.contents = r.contents ∧
      o.singularTags = [] ∧ o.output.role = .request ∧ o.output.datum = .inline ∧
      o.output.lovelace = r.contents.lovelace ∧ o.output.stateTokens = 0 ∧
      o.output.assets = [])

def observesTermination (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : TerminationRequest) : Bool :=
  match economicLookup u r.reference with
  | none => false
  | some o => decide (o.request = some (.termination r) ∧ o.contents = r.contents ∧
      o.singularTags = r.singularTags ∧ o.output.role = .request ∧
      o.output.datum = .inline ∧ o.output.lovelace = r.contents.lovelace ∧
      o.output.stateTokens = 0 ∧ o.output.assets = [])

def economicObservationRefusal (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo)
    (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Option String :=
  if ¬ (u.map Prod.fst).Nodup then some "unspent-reference-duplicate"
  else if !(u.all fun p => p.1.tx != tx.identity) then some "transaction-identity-not-fresh"
  else if !observesWorld world u then some "request-observation-mismatch"
  else if tx.outputs.map (·.output) != tx.transaction.outputs ||
      !(tx.outputs.all fun o => o.output.lovelace == o.contents.lovelace) then
    some "output-observation-mismatch"
  else none

def exactBurns {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (held : List α) (mint : List (α × Int)) : Bool :=
  (held ++ mint.map Prod.fst).all fun tag =>
    decide (((mint.filter fun p => decide (p.1 = tag)).map Prod.snd).sum =
      -(Int.ofNat (held.count tag)))
def applicationTagIdentity (tag : Approval) : TokenId := ⟨tag.policy, tag.assetName⟩

def requestTagsBurned (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Bool :=
  let spent := economicSpent u tx
  exactBurns (spent.flatMap (·.contents.trieReadyTags)) tx.trieReadyMint &&
    exactBurns ((spent.flatMap (·.contents.applicationTags)).map applicationTagIdentity)
      tx.applicationMint &&
    tx.outputs.all (fun o => o.contents.trieReadyTags.isEmpty && o.contents.applicationTags.isEmpty)

def refundOwed (requests : List RegistrationRequest) (retraction : Bool)
    (address : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((requests.filter fun r => r.refundAddress == address).map
    fun r => refundAmount r retraction).sum

def refundObligations (requests : List RegistrationRequest) (retraction : Bool) :
    List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (requests.map (·.refundAddress)).eraseDups.map fun address =>
    (address, refundOwed requests retraction address)

def rejectedRequests (world : World) (members : List (OutRef × RejectReason)) :
    List RegistrationRequest :=
  members.filterMap fun member =>
    (world.pending.find? fun b => b.request.reference == member.1).map (·.request)

def registrationRejectionGround (world : World) (r : RegistrationRequest)
    (interval : Interval) (ground : RejectReason) : Option String :=
  match ground with
  | .mismatch leaf =>
    if leaf != trieGet world.registry.trie r.key then some "reject-evidence-mismatch"
    else if (transition .insertActive leaf).isSome then some "reject-compatible"
    else none
  | .expired =>
    if interval.lower < r.submittedAt + world.registry.config.processTime +
        world.registry.config.retractTime then some "reject-not-expired"
    else none

def terminationRejectionGround (world : World) (r : TerminationRequest)
    (ground : RejectReason) : Option String :=
  match ground with
  | .mismatch leaf =>
    if leaf != trieGet world.registry.trie r.key then some "reject-evidence-mismatch"
    else if (transition .updateTerminal leaf).isSome then some "reject-compatible"
    else none
  | .expired => some "reject-termination-no-expiry"

def rejectionMemberRefusal (world : World) (interval : Interval)
    (member : OutRef × RejectReason) : Option String :=
  match world.pending.find? (fun b => b.request.reference == member.1) with
  | some b => registrationRejectionGround world b.request interval member.2
  | none =>
    match world.terminations.find? (fun b => b.request.reference == member.1) with
    | some b =>
      match terminationRejectionGround world b.request member.2 with
      | some why => some why
      | none => some "reject-termination"
    | none => some "reject-request-not-pending"

def rejectionStateRefusal (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : Rejection) : Option String :=
  if !inputsContainReference r.transaction.transaction.referenceInputs r.stateReference then
    some "reject-state-reference-missing"
  else match economicLookup u r.stateReference with
  | none => some "reference-input-missing"
  | some o =>
    if o.output.stateTokens != 1 || o.output.role != .state then some "reject-state-token-missing"
    else match o.output.stateToken with
    | none => some "reject-state-token-missing"
    | some token =>
      if token.policy != world.registry.config.stateToken.policy then some "reject-foreign-state"
      else if token.name != world.registry.config.stateToken.name then some "reject-state-token-name"
      else if o.output.datum != .inline then some "reject-state-datum"
      else match o.output.config with
      | none => some "reject-state-datum"
      | some config =>
        if config.root != rootOf world.registry.trie then some "reject-stale-state"
        else if config != world.registry.config then some "reject-state-configuration"
        else none

def rejectionInputsRefusal (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : Rejection) : Option String :=
  let tx := r.transaction.transaction
  if inputsContainReference tx.inputs r.stateReference &&
      inputsContainReference tx.referenceInputs r.stateReference then some "reject-state-overlap"
  else if (spentOutputs u.ledger tx).any (fun o => o.stateTokens > 0 || o.role == .state) then
    some "reject-state-spent"
  else if ¬ (tx.inputs.map (·.ref)).Nodup ∨ ¬ (r.members.map Prod.fst).Nodup then
    some "reject-duplicate-input"
  else if !disjointInputs tx then some "reject-input-overlap"
  else inputPresenceRefusal u.ledger tx

def rejectionSupplyUnchanged (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Bool :=
  tx.transaction.mint.isEmpty && tx.stateMint.isEmpty && tx.singularMint.isEmpty &&
    (economicSpent u tx).all (fun o => o.output.stateTokens == 0 &&
      o.output.assets.isEmpty && o.singularTags.isEmpty && o.contents.otherAssets.isEmpty) &&
    tx.outputs.all (fun o => o.output.stateTokens == 0 && o.output.assets.isEmpty &&
      o.singularTags.isEmpty && o.contents.otherAssets.isEmpty)

def rejectionRefusal (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : Rejection) : Option String := do
  if let some why := rejectionInputsRefusal u r then return why
  if let some why := rejectionStateRefusal world u r then return why
  if let some why := economicObservationRefusal world u r.transaction then return why
  let some interval := r.transaction.transaction.validity | return "reject-interval-missing"
  if ¬ interval.valid then return "reject-interval-empty"
  if r.members.isEmpty then return "reject-empty-batch"
  if ¬ (r.transaction.transaction.inputs.map (·.ref)).Perm
      (r.members.map fun m => some m.1) then return "reject-input-members"
  if let some why := r.members.findSome? (rejectionMemberRefusal world interval) then return why
  if !requestTagsBurned u r.transaction then return "reject-tag-not-burned"
  if !rejectionSupplyUnchanged u r.transaction then return "reject-registry-supply"
  if let some why := refundRefusal r.transaction
      (refundObligations (rejectedRequests world r.members) false) "reject-refund-short" then
    return why
  none

def rejectionAccepted (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo) (r : Rejection) : Except String World :=
  match rejectionRefusal world u r with
  | some why => .error why
  | none => .ok (rejectionEffect world r)

def retractionInputsRefusal (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Option String :=
  if (spentOutputs u.ledger tx.transaction).any (fun o => o.stateTokens > 0 || o.role == .state)
  then some "retract-state-spent"
  else if (u.filter fun p => inputsContainReference tx.transaction.referenceInputs p.1).any
      (fun p => p.2.output.stateTokens > 0 || p.2.output.role == .state)
  then some "retract-state-read"
  else if ¬ (tx.transaction.inputs.map (·.ref)).Nodup then some "retract-duplicate-input"
  else if !disjointInputs tx.transaction then some "retract-input-overlap"
  else inputPresenceRefusal u.ledger tx.transaction

def retractionRequest (world : World) (tx : EconomicTransaction) :
    Except String RegistrationRequest := do
  if world.terminations.any (fun b =>
      inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs b.request.reference) then
    throw "retract-registration-only"
  match world.pending.filter (fun b =>
      inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs b.request.reference) with
  | [] => throw "retract-request-not-pending"
  | [booking] => pure booking.request
  | _ => throw "retract-single-request"

def retractionRefusal (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo)
    (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Option String := do
  if let some why := retractionInputsRefusal u tx then return why
  if let some why := economicObservationRefusal world u tx then return why
  match retractionRequest world tx with
  | .error why => return why
  | .ok request =>
    if let some why := retractionFundingRefusal u tx request then return why
    if !(tx.transaction.signers.contains request.refundAddress) then return "retract-owner"
    let some interval := tx.transaction.validity | return "retract-interval-missing"
    if ¬ interval.valid then return "retract-interval-empty"
    if interval.lower < request.submittedAt + world.registry.config.processTime ||
        request.submittedAt + world.registry.config.processTime + world.registry.config.retractTime <
          interval.upper then return "retract-window"
    if !requestTagsBurned u tx then return "retract-tag-not-burned"
    if !(tx.outputs.all foldBareValue) || !((economicSpent u tx).all foldBareValue) then
      return "retract-foreign-asset"
    if !rejectionSupplyUnchanged u tx then return "retract-registry-supply"
    if let some why := refundRefusal tx (refundObligations [request] true) "retract-refund-short"
      then return why
    if tx.transaction.donation != 0 then return "retract-donation"
    if retractionFundingLovelace u tx request < tx.transaction.fee then
      return "retract-fee-funding-short"
    if !balanced u.ledger tx.transaction then return "retract-unbalanced"
    none

def retractionAccepted (world : World) (u : EconomicUtxo)
    (tx : EconomicTransaction) : Except String World :=
  match retractionRefusal world u tx with
  | some why => .error why
  | none => .ok (retractionEffect world tx)

def retractionFunding (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction)
    (request : RegistrationRequest) : List EconomicOutput :=
  (u.filter fun entry => inputsContainReference tx.transaction.inputs entry.1 &&
    entry.1 != request.reference).map Prod.snd

def retractionFundingRefusal (u : EconomicUtxo) (tx : EconomicTransaction)
    (request : RegistrationRequest) : Option String :=
  (retractionFunding u tx request).findSome? fun output =>
    if output.output.stateTokens > 0 || output.output.role == .state then
      some "retract-state-spent"
    else if !output.contents.trieReadyTags.isEmpty then some "retract-funding-trie-ready-tag"
    else if !output.contents.applicationTags.isEmpty then some "retract-funding-application-tag"
    else if !output.singularTags.isEmpty then some "retract-funding-singular-tag"
    else if output.output.role == .request then some "retract-funding-request-address"
    else if output.request.isSome then some "retract-funding-request"
    else none

def terminationDeclaredLovelace (r : TerminationRequest) : Nat :=
  r.declaredTip + r.carrierAda

def terminationCustody (registry : RegistryState) (key : Key) : List Holding :=
  registry.held.filter fun h => h.key == key && h.kind == .active

def terminationBookingRefusal (registry : RegistryState) (b : TerminationBooking) : Option String :=
  let c := registry.config
  let r := b.request
  if !terminationContentsShape c r || r.contents.lovelace < terminationDeclaredLovelace r then
    some "dirty-request"
  else if terminationDeclaredLovelace r < r.contents.lovelace then
    some "hidden-surplus"
  else if !decide (r.registryId = c.registryId ∧ r.singularTags = [c.singularTag r.key]) then
    some "forged-singular-tag"
  else if !decide (r.contents.trieReadyTags = [r.trieReadyTag c] ∧ b.trieReadyTagsMinted = [r.trieReadyTag c]) then
    some "forged-trie-ready-tag"
  else if !decide (trieGet registry.trie r.key = .known .active) ||
      (terminationCustody registry r.key).isEmpty then
    some "singular-tag-not-in-custody"
  else if !decide (b.custodyInputs = terminationCustody registry r.key ∧ b.custodyInputs.length = 1) then
    some "forged-singular-tag"
  else none
abbrev Utxo := List (OutRef × TxOutput)

def inputsContainReference (inputs : List TxInput) (ref : OutRef) : Bool :=
  inputs.any fun i => decide (i.ref = some ref)

def disjointInputs (tx : Tx) : Bool :=
  tx.referenceInputs.all fun i =>
    match i.ref with
    | none => true
    | some ref => !inputsContainReference tx.inputs ref

def inputPresent (u : Utxo) (i : TxInput) : Bool :=
  match i.ref with
  | none => false
  | some ref => u.any fun p => decide (p.1 = ref)

def inputPresenceRefusal (u : Utxo) (tx : Tx) : Option String :=
  if !(tx.inputs.all (inputPresent u)) then some "spent-input-missing"
  else if !(tx.referenceInputs.all (inputPresent u)) then some "reference-input-missing"
  else none

def spentOutputs (u : Utxo) (tx : Tx) : List TxOutput :=
  (u.filter fun p => inputsContainReference tx.inputs p.1).map Prod.snd
def outputLovelace (outputs : List TxOutput) : Nat := (outputs.map (·.lovelace)).sum
def outputAssets (outputs : List TxOutput) : List (Asset × Int) := outputs.flatMap (·.assets)

def stateTokenValue (outputs : List TxOutput) (token : Option TokenId) : Nat :=
  ((outputs.filter fun o => decide (o.stateToken = token)).map (·.stateTokens)).sum

def stateTokenSupport (before after : List TxOutput) : List (Option TokenId) :=
  before.map (·.stateToken) ++ after.map (·.stateToken)

def balanced (u : Utxo) (tx : Tx) : Bool :=
  let spent := spentOutputs u tx
  outputLovelace spent == outputLovelace tx.outputs + tx.donation + tx.fee &&
  assetSame (outputAssets spent ++ tx.mint) (outputAssets tx.outputs) &&
  (stateTokenSupport spent tx.outputs).all fun token =>
    stateTokenValue spent token == stateTokenValue tx.outputs token
abbrev RequestPool := List RegistrationBooking

def book (world : World) (booking : RegistrationBooking) : Except String World :=
  match registrationBookingRefusal world.registry.config booking with
  | some reason => .error reason
  | none =>
    if world.pending.any (fun pending => decide (pending.request.reference = booking.request.reference)) ||
        world.terminations.any (fun pending => decide (pending.request.reference = booking.request.reference)) then
      .error "request-already-pending"
    else .ok { world with pending := booking :: world.pending }

def inPhase1 (c : Config) (submittedAt validTo : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (validTo ≤ submittedAt + c.processTime)
abbrev Asset := TokenKind × Key

def assetKind (ds : List (Asset × Int)) (x : Asset) : Int :=
  ds.foldl (fun n p => if p.1 == x then n + p.2 else n) 0

def assetSame (a b : List (Asset × Int)) : Bool :=
  (a.map Prod.fst ++ b.map Prod.fst).all fun x => assetKind a x == assetKind b x

def Config.trieReadyTag (c : Config) (commitment : Nat) : TokenId :=
  ⟨c.registryId, commitment + 1⟩

def bookingCommitment (domain : Nat) (fields : List Nat) : Nat :=
  (fnv1a (toJson (domain :: fields)).compress.toUTF8.data.toList).toNat

def applicationTagAssetName (key refundAddress destination nonce : Nat) : Nat :=
  bookingCommitment 0 [(edgeOrdinal .insertActive).toNat, key, refundAddress, destination, nonce]

def trieReadyTagAssetName (operation : BookingOperation) (nonce : Nat) : Nat :=
  bookingCommitment 1 ((match operation with
    | .registration key refundAddress destination cost tip carrier =>
      [0, key, refundAddress, destination, cost, tip, carrier]
    | .termination key destination => [1, key, destination]) ++ [nonce])

def RegistrationRequest.operation (r : RegistrationRequest) : BookingOperation :=
  .registration r.key r.refundAddress r.destination r.registrationCost r.declaredTip r.carrierAda

def RegistrationRequest.trieReadyTag (r : RegistrationRequest) (c : Config) : TokenId :=
  c.trieReadyTag (trieReadyTagAssetName r.operation r.nonce)

def allowed (e : Edge) : Bool :=
  e == .insertActive || e == .updateTerminal

def delta (e : Edge) : List (TokenKind × Int) :=
  match e with
  | .insertActive => [(.active, 1)]
  | .updateTerminal => [(.active, -1)]
  | _ => []

def transition (e : Edge) (before : Leaf) : Option Leaf :=
  match e, before with
  | .insertActive, .unknown => some (.known .active)
  | .updateTerminal, .known .active => some (.known .terminal)
  | _, _ => none
def Action := Request

def assetDelta (a : Action) : List (Asset × Int) :=
  (delta a.edge).map fun p => ((p.1, a.key), p.2)

def requestClaim (b : Action) : List (Asset × Int) :=
  b.claimed.map fun p => ((p.1, b.key), p.2)

def claimedMint (batch : List Action) : List (Asset × Int) :=
  batch.foldl (fun acc b => assetPlus acc (requestClaim b)) []

def actualMint (batch : List Action) : List (Asset × Int) :=
  batch.foldl (fun acc b => assetPlus acc (assetDelta b)) []

def admitsFor (c : Config) (r : Request) (approval : Option Approval) : Bool :=
  match approval with
    | none => false
    | some ap =>
      ap.policy == c.applicationPolicy && ap.edge == r.edge && ap.key == r.key &&
        ap.owner == r.owner && ap.destination == requestDestination r &&
        ap.assetName == approvalAssetName ap.edge ap.key ap.owner ap.destination

def refusal (s : RegistryState) (a : Action) : Option String :=
  if !allowed a.edge then some "edge-inadmissible"
  else match a.approval with
    | none => some "no-approval"
    | some ap =>
      if ap.policy != s.config.applicationPolicy then some "no-approval"
      else if !admitsFor s.config a a.approval then some "approval-mismatch"
      else
        let before := trieGet s.trie a.key
        let activePresent := s.held.any fun h => h.key == a.key && h.kind == .active
        match a.edge, before with
        | .insertActive, .unknown => none
        | .insertActive, _ => some "key-exists"
        | .updateTerminal, .known .active =>
            if activePresent then none else some "token-missing"
        | .updateTerminal, .unknown => some "key-unknown"
        | .updateTerminal, .known .absent => some "not-booked"
        | .updateTerminal, .known .terminal => some "terminal-immutable"
        | _, _ => some "edge-inadmissible"

def emptyResult (s : RegistryState) : Result :=
  { state := s, mint := [], paid := [] }

def combineResults (first rest : Result) : Result :=
  { state := rest.state, mint := assetPlus first.mint rest.mint, paid := first.paid ++ rest.paid }

def step (s : RegistryState) (a : Action) : Except String Result :=
  match refusal s a with
  | some why => .error why
  | none => .ok (applyEdge s a)

def foldActions (s : RegistryState) (batch : List Action) : Except String Result :=
  match batch with
  | [] => .ok (emptyResult s)
  | b :: bs => do
    let first ← step s b
    let rest ← foldActions first.state bs
    pure (combineResults first rest)

def batchConsumesCreated (batch : List Request) : Option String := go [] batch
where
  go (created : List Key) : List Request → Option String
    | [] => none
    | r :: rs =>
      if r.edge == .updateTerminal && created.contains r.key then some "token-missing"
      else go (if r.edge == .insertActive then r.key :: created else created) rs

def foldBatch (s : RegistryState) (batch : List Action) : Except String Result := do
  if batch.isEmpty then throw "empty-fold"
  let r ← foldActions s batch
  if assetSame (claimedMint batch) (actualMint batch) then
    match batchConsumesCreated batch with
    | some why => throw why
    | none => pure r
  else throw "net-mint-mismatch"
abbrev Key := Nat

def stateByte (s : State) : UInt8 :=
  match s with | .absent => 0x00 | .active => 0x01 | .terminal => 0x02
def Interval.width (i : Interval) : Nat := i.upper - i.lower
def Interval.valid (i : Interval) : Prop := i.lower < i.upper
def Config.stateToken (c : Config) : TokenId := ⟨c.registryId, 0⟩

def fnv1a (bs : List UInt8) : UInt64 :=
  bs.foldl (fun h b => (h ^^^ b.toUInt64) * 16777619) 14695981039346656037

def u64bytes (n : UInt64) : List UInt8 :=
  [(n >>> 56).toNat.toUInt8, (n >>> 48).toNat.toUInt8, (n >>> 40).toNat.toUInt8,
   (n >>> 32).toNat.toUInt8, (n >>> 24).toNat.toUInt8, (n >>> 16).toNat.toUInt8,
   (n >>> 8).toNat.toUInt8, n.toNat.toUInt8]
abbrev Trie := List (Key × Leaf)

def trieGet (t : Trie) (k : Key) : Leaf :=
  ((t.filter (·.1 == k)).head?).map (·.2) |>.getD .unknown

def trieSet (t : Trie) (k : Key) (l : Leaf) : Trie :=
  (k, l) :: t.filter (fun p => p.1 != k)

def leafByte (l : Leaf) : UInt8 :=
  match l with | .unknown => 0xFF | .known s => stateByte s

def datumFormOf : Option Nat → DatumForm
  | some _ => .inline
  | none => .none

def edgeOrdinal (e : Edge) : UInt8 :=
  match e with
  | .insertAbsent => 0 | .insertActive => 1 | .updateActive => 2
  | .updateTerminal => 3 | .deleteAbsent => 4 | .deleteActive => 5
  | .witnessTerminal => 6

def approvalAssetName (e : Edge) (key owner destination : Nat) : Nat :=
  ((fnv1a [edgeOrdinal e, key.toUInt8, owner.toUInt8, destination.toUInt8]) &&& 0xFFFFFFFF).toNat

def requestDestination (r : Request) : Nat :=
  if r.edge == .insertAbsent then 0 else r.output

def Config.singularTag (c : Config) (key : Key) : SingularTag :=
  ⟨c.registryId, ⟨c.activePolicy, key⟩⟩

def TerminationRequest.operation (r : TerminationRequest) : BookingOperation :=
  .termination r.key r.destination

def TerminationRequest.trieReadyTag (r : TerminationRequest) (c : Config) : TokenId :=
  c.trieReadyTag (trieReadyTagAssetName r.operation r.nonce)
